name: @etzhayyim/animeka-kotoba
description: kotoba reference implementation of the animeka PUBLICATION CATALOG (works + episodes with IPFS output CID + publish/announce status) using @etzhayyim/sdk. Registry on AT PDS (replaces vertex_animeka work/episode). Mixed split: the ComfyUI/USD GPU generation pipeline + LangGraph checkpointer stays etzhayyim infra (consent-capability); only the consumer-facing catalog is etzhayyim-front. Substrate posture per ADR-2605172000 + ADR-2606011400.
